OPDUIRMA.english_text: This variable provides information on the presence or absence of Intraretinal Microvascular Abnormalities (IRMA), from the worse eye. Both males and females 40 YEARS -

OPDUVB.english_text: This variable provides information on the presence or absence of retinal venous beading from the worse eye.  Venous beading is a manifestation of severe retinal ischemia.

OPDUNVO.english_text: This variable provides information on the presence or absence of retinal new vessels on the optic disc area, from the worse eye. Eyes with standard>=10A have more new vessels than eyes with standard <10A.
OPDUNVO.target:
Both males and females 40 YEARS -
			150 YEARS

OPDUNVE.english_text: This variable provides information on the presence or absence of retinal new vessels elsewhere outside the optic disc margin in the worse eye. OPDUNVE.target:
Both males and females 40 YEARS -
			150 YEARS

OPDURFP.english_text: This variable provides information on the presence or absence of retinal fibrous proliferation in the worse eye.  Retinal fibrous proliferation is a manifestation of proliferative retinopathy due to retinal ischemia.  The more area affected, the greater the disease.

Both males and females 40 YEARS -
			150 YEARS

OPDUPHVH.english_text: This variable provides information on the presence or absence of pre-retinal hemorrhage or vitreous hemorrhage in the worse eye. Both males and females 40 YEARS -
			150 YEARS

PSQ210.english_text: Although it is possible that men who have a high PSA may have prostate cancer, they probably just have a large prostate.

PSQ220.english_text: Additional tests are usually required for your doctor to determine if a high PSA is caused by cancer or some other condition.

PSQ230.english_text: Some men who develop prostate cancer live to be 70 years of age or more.

PSQ240.english_text: Some men who develop prostate cancer may have rapid disease and die within five years.

PSQ250.english_text: Men are at a higher risk for developing prostate cancer if they have more than one relative, their father, or a brother that have been diagnosed with prostate cancer.

PSQ260.english_text: African American men have a higher risk of developing prostate cancer compared to other racial/ethnic groups.

PSQ270.english_text: There are several different types of treatment available to men diagnosed with prostate cancer.

PSQ280.english_text: Almost all options for treating and managing prostate cancer have some risk of side effects, including, loss of bladder control and problems with sexual performance.

PSQ290.english_text: There are support groups for men with prostate cancer.
